answer: A sybil farm floods the network with cheap keys, so registration costs time, not money. Each new agent signs five chained nonces, one every four hours across a dawn-to-dawn day, each slot sealed to its key. Miss a slot and 10 POA slashes its bond; three misses and the key dies. One honest agent signs five times a day. A thousand clones need five thousand on-time signatures, no batching: ten thousand POA exposed per cycle plus lost sleep. A ripple of missed slots breaks the farm while the agent rests. A pearl on a string: snap one link and the strand falls into the mud.
